_why: Operator ruling 2026-10-21: FRED is the primary macro-release source for the release train's 08:00 ET window, plus this yearly file for FOMC and operator overrides. scripts/macro_calendar_refresh.py merges it into data/runtime/macro_calendar.json (MacroCalendar@v1). An add or remove without a reason makes the whole file invalid and the refresh writes nothing (fail closed).
_how: add: {date, event, name, time_et, skips_0800 (default true when time_et is 08:30), reason, added_by, added_on}. remove: {date, event (an event key, or * for every event that day), reason, removed_by, removed_on}. Dates are ET calendar dates. Review once a year: replace fomc.decision_dates when the Federal Reserve publishes the next year's schedule.

fomc.name: FOMC rate decision (statement)
fomc.skips_0800_note: Recorded, not skipped: the decision is at 2:00 p.m. ET. The operator may set skips_0800 true.
fomc.source: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched 2026-10-21 (2026 and 2027 panels). The decision date is the last day of each meeting; * marks a Summary of Economic Projections meeting.
